Identification_Area.title: Optical Constants of Laboratory Generated Titan Atmospheric Aerosol Analogs

Investigation.name: Optical Constants of Laboratory Generated Titan Atmospheric Aerosol Analogs
Investigation.description: This archive contains experimentally measured complex refractive indices of laboratory-generated organic refractory materials (tholins) produced at low temperature (150 K) using plasma chemistry in the stream of a supersonic expansion in NASA Ames’ COsmic SImulation Chamber (COSmIC) facility. The COSmIC tholin samples were produced from various gas mixtures representative of Titan, Pluto, Jupiter, and exoplanet atmospheric compositions with a high voltage of -700V. The real (n) and imaginary (k) parts of the complex index of refraction were determined from reflectance and transmission spectroscopic measurements conducted with the Optical Constants Facility and/or the Soleil Synchrotron AILES beamline facility.
